analysis.summary: Vikram Thermo reported a revenue from continuing operations of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs for FY 2024-25, up from Rs. 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24. Standalone Profit After Tax stood at Rs. 809.85 lakhs, with the overall decrease primarily reflecting the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business unit.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company focuses on building a sustainable business model with profitable revenue growth and launching high-margin research-based products.
guidance.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

guidance.claim: Management stated that in fiscal 2024, the company will enter new markets with favorable competition and work on new and complex products.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

guidance.claim: The company plans to leverage its R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and customer-centric products to reach newer heights.
guidance.quote: We will leverage our R&D capabilities, domain expertise, and our customer-centric products to attain newer heights.

demand_outlook.claim: Vikram Thermo's PAN-India presence and expanding global footprint have significantly contributed to its growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's presence across India and expanding global footprint in newer territories have yielded positive results.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred Rs. 27,81,809.43 in R&D revenue expenditure in FY 2024-25, representing 0.21% of total revenue, with zero R&D capital expenditure.
capex_expansion.quote: Capital Expenditure - Nil Revenue Expenditure - Rs.27,81,809.43 Total - Rs.27,81,809.43 R&D Expenditure as % of total revenue 0.21%

capex_expansion.claim: Equity shares of Vikram Aroma Limited have been allotted to the shareholders of Vikram Thermo (India) Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The equity shares of resulting company M/s Vikram Aroma Limited have already been allotted to the shareholders of your company and we are awaiting the final approval of BSE/SEBI for the listing/trading of the shares of Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred Rs. 16,07,578.44 in revenue expenditure towards Research and Development.
The Board approved a scheme of arrangement to demerge the Aromatic Chemical Business (Unit II) into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred nil capital expenditure on Research and Development during the financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Profit After Tax decreased primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, while continuing operations showed notable improvement.
margins_costs.quote: While the PAT reflects a decrease primarily due to the demerger of a business unit, the overall performance of the continuing operations has shown notable improvement.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest-ever revenue and profit after tax during FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: The revenue of Rs. 12639.54 lacs and profit after tax of Rs. 2537.87 lacs is best ever in the history of the company.

margins_costs.claim: Profit before tax increased to Rs. 3,406.14 Lakhs in FY 2023-24 from Rs. 2,303.51 Lakhs in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: PBT increased to Rs. 3406.14 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 2303.51 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased to Rs. 2,537.87 Lakhs in FY 2023-24 compared to Rs. 1,691.29 Lakhs in FY 2022-23.
margins_costs.quote: PAT increased to Rs. 2537.87 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 1691.29 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2022-23.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any amount from profits to reserves for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 7.5% or Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The dividend payout for the year will result in a total financial outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 2,35,18,388/- (Previous Year Rs. 1,56,78,925/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during FY 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 5% dividend amounting to Rs. 0.50 per share on post-bonus equity capital.
capital_allocation.quote: your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.50 per share on post bonus enhanced paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will involve a total financial outflow of Rs. 1,56,78,925.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs.1,56,78,925/- (Previous Year Rs.94,07,355/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 25,086,280 bonus shares of Rs. 10 each on May 14, 2022.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's risk framework involves identifying external and internal risks and ensuring readiness for extreme events like calamities and disasters.
risks_headwinds.quote: The process involves identifying both external and internal risks and the readiness to respond to extreme risks like calamities and disasters.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company implemented a Risk Management Policy to evaluate internal and external risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The demerger will help isolate risks between the respective businesses and enable independent capital raising.
risks_headwinds.quote: The demerger would also help each company to isolate the risks between their respective businesses, raise capital based on their individual requirements and unlock value in future.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company navigated global uncertainties and challenges stemming from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth via high-margin, research-driven products.
management_commitments.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to consistent investment in R&D, adopting emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to investing in R&D and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: The Board pledged to address secretarial audit qualifications and ensure compliance in the future.
management_commitments.quote: The Board has also undertaken to take care of such qualification and to comply with the same in future.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to continuing its transformation journey in fiscal 2024 by focusing on complex products and entering new markets with favorable competition.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
